primary_metrics.Q_hard_rem: mean reward on implement rows where stage_family=removal and severity>=hard_threshold
primary_metrics.R_hard_rem: mean of action1*reward on implement rows where stage_family=removal and severity>=hard_threshold
primary_metrics.P_easy_action0: mean of action0*reward on implement rows where severity<=easy_threshold
primary_metrics.P_easy_waitlike: mean of wait_like*reward on implement rows where severity<=easy_threshold
primary_metrics.M_ins: mean reward on implement rows where stage_family=insertion and severity>=hard_threshold
